purpose: Validate a fixed image-registration correction on a second tile before any labelled calibration experiment.
scope: Same acquisition, different tile. Not a new independent Sentinel scene or a detection test.
inputs: Publisher georeferenced float TIFF, pinned by revision and verified Git LFS SHA-256
Native VV DN blocks, source calibration LUT and geolocation metadata
No mask or polygon is used to estimate or score the registration shift
procedure: Record both TIFF bounding boxes and overlap fraction; do not infer tile independence from filenames.
Use the existing NumPy bilinear geolocation inversion and sigma0 calibration without changing formulas.
Compare NumPy integer FFT peak against skimage; report disagreement as failure.
Apply only the fixed development shift for the transfer result, with order-1 interpolation and no wrapping.
Report before/after statistics on the interior excluding eight pixels from each border.
Estimate the check tile shift independently as a diagnostic, without replacing the fixed shift.
Report every result even if criteria fail; do not tune the fixed shift on the check sample.
limitations: Passing these checks only supports within-acquisition transfer of a registration estimate.
Image correlation and the chosen 0.25-pixel tolerance do not establish absolute geolocation accuracy.
Radiometric units, thermal-noise correction and exporter processing history remain separate questions.
No detection score, algorithm ranking or calibration-benefit claim is authorized by this check alone.
